extracted.name: Impossibly Easy Coconut Pie
extracted.description: This impossible coconut pie recipe blends and bakes milk, eggs, flaked coconut, and a few other easy ingredients into amazing coconut custard pie.
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease and flour a 10-inch pie plate.
Place milk, coconut, eggs, butter, sugar, flour, and vanilla in a blender; blend until well mixed. Pour into prepared pie plate. Sprinkle nutmeg on top.
Bake in the preheated oven until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean, about 45 minutes.
